name: stylelift
description: Capture any website — one page or the whole site — as an editable HTML / React / Elementor project (Framer, Webflow, GSAP and other animated sites included), plus a DESIGN.md design-system reference measured from the live page.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-wp-plugin.mjs && node scripts/build-runtime.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: node scripts/verify.mjs && node scripts/verify-component.mjs && node scripts/verify-edit.mjs && node scripts/verify-jsx.mjs && node scripts/verify-offline.mjs && node scripts/verify-project.mjs && node scripts/verify-site.mjs && node scripts/verify-studio-model.mjs && node scripts/verify-variants.mjs && node scripts/verify-wordpress.mjs && node scripts/verify-mirror.mjs && node scripts/verify-preview.mjs && node scripts/verify-publish.mjs && node scripts/verify-report.mjs && node scripts/verify-align.mjs && node scripts/verify-motion.mjs
scripts.build:test: node scripts/build-wp-plugin.mjs && node scripts/build-runtime.mjs && vite build --outDir dist-test && touch dist-test/.metadata_never_index
